about.title: About Lingo-Translate
about.desc: A next-generation game translation tool developed using Pure Go (`CGO_ENABLED=0`) and modern web technologies, designed for speed, stability, and automated translation for visual novels and RPGs.
about.feature_pure_go: Pure Go: No dependencies—install and run right away
about.feature_engines: Supports RPG Maker (MV/MZ), Ren'Py, Godot, Unity, and libGDX
about.feature_injection: Non-destructive Injection: Preserves the original game files without corrupting the game
about.feature_mcp: Built-in Model Context Protocol (MCP) for AI Coding Agents
